extracted.intended_audience: OpenReview users who manage or query reviewer/AC assignments (venue admins, area chairs, program chairs, or developers scripting against the OpenReview API)
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step instructions for finding all paper assignment edges for a specific user on an OpenReview venue, either via the public API endpoint or the openreview-py Python client. Includes the required query parameters and minimal client usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignments are stored as edges
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states that assignments are represented as edge objects in OpenReview; therefore retrieving assignments means querying edges associated with the venue's assignment invitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: View assignment edges via API endpoint
rubrics_metrics.description: In your browser search bar, enter: api2.openreview.net/edges?invitation=<your_venue_id>/Reviewers/-/Assignment&groupBy=tail
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This brings up all of the assignment edges for all of your venue's reviewers. If you want assignments for Area Chairs, change 'Reviewers' to 'Area_Chairs'. The groupBy=tail parameter groups/returns edges by the tail (reviewer profile).

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter assignments to a particular reviewer using tail
rubrics_metrics.description: To see only the assignments for reviewer ~User_One1, change your search query to: api2.openreview.net/edges?invitation=<your_venue_id>/Reviewers/-/Assignment&tail=~User_One1
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 'tail' field in an edge corresponds to the profile ID of the assigned reviewer; including tail=<profile_id> restricts results to that user.

rubrics_metrics.name: Install and instantiate the openreview-py client before using Python examples
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have not done so, you will need to install and instantiate the openreview-py client.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a prerequisite for the Python client example; ensure the client is properly authenticated/initialized before calling get_all_edges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set tail variable to the user's profile ID in the Python client
rubrics_metrics.description: Set a variable 'tail' to the profile ID of the user you are interested in, for example: tail = "~User_One1"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the exact profile ID string (e.g., ~User_One1) as the tail parameter when calling the client API.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set invitation variable to the correct assignment invitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Set a variable 'invitation' to the invitation of the edges you are trying to view. If your user of interest is a reviewer, the invitation would be in the format <your_venue_id>/Reviewers/-/Assignment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If querying Area Chairs instead, replace 'Reviewers' with 'Area_Chairs' (i.e., <your_venue_id>/Area_Chairs/-/Assignment). Use the venue's full id.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retrieve assignment edges with client.get_all_edges(invitation, tail)
rubrics_metrics.description: Retrieve all of the edges posted to that invitation for the user of interest: edges = client.get_all_edges(invitation=invitation, tail=tail)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This Python client call returns all matching edge objects for the given invitation and tail. Ensure invitation and tail variables are set correctly and the client is instantiated.
